subject.title: TUI /sessions list: gateway-injected inbound metadata block used as session title (shows 'untrusted metadata' for all sessions)

question: Should maintainers replace the stale conflicting fork PR with a fresh target-repo fix for the gateway/TUI session-title bug?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-proven, but an open fork PR already uses closing syntax and the issue is labeled not to create another fix PR automatically, so automation should wait for maintainer routing.

options.title: Replace with fresh target-repo fix
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow maintainer-controlled PR that covers both sync and async session-list title paths, then close the stale fork copy after replacement exists.

options.title: Ask the fork author to refresh
options.body: Keep the fork PR as the candidate only if it is rebased, conflict-free, and supplies real behavior proof for the TUI/session-list path.

options.title: Defer to broader title work
options.body: Leave this issue blocked behind broader title-quality decisions, but the metadata-title regression remains unresolved until a specific bug fix lands.

recommendation.title: Replace with fresh target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow maintainer-controlled PR that covers both sync and async session-list title paths, then close the stale fork copy after replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing owner from the original title-derivation commit and later gateway session-list performance work.
